content:
sam: Quick check — the runtime guide curl example 404s for me after the recent anchor cleanup. did we push the redirect? @maria @jen
maria: oof, thanks for flagging. I saw a failing link in CI but thought it was queued for the shortlink job.
sam: Repro steps:
```
curl -sS https://docs.redwood.ai/runtime/examples/curl | head
# returns 404
```
maria: ah that's the page that got the fragment rename. PR open at https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842 — I left a note to add a redirect but didn't get to the deploy step.
jen: I can take the deploy hook, leaves are light today. is this blocking any customer flows?
sam: Not customer-facing yet, but blocks a quick smoke test for the canary rollout of batching changes.
kevin: @jen if you deploy, can you also add a tiny test to CI that curls that path? then we won't regress again.
jen: yep, will deploy and add a one-liner job. ETA ~30m. @docs-bot can you add an item to the docs backlog: "smoke-test: runtime curl path"? :memo:
docs-bot: Added backlog item #1284 assigned to docs-team. :white_check_mark:
sam: Thanks all. pinging in standup in case anyone wants to pair on the CI job later. :thumbsup:
